summary.name: JeanPhilAI
summary.one_liner: JeanPhilAI is an independent fan tool that turns one adult face photo into a roughly 12–15 second vertical clip in the style of the AI-generated "Jean Phil" character, with AI ambient audio.
use_cases: Make a short vertical meme clip from one selfie
Create a TikTok or Reels video in the Jean Phil style
Try a face-swap template with a single photo
Generate a short AI video with ambient sound
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a generator that takes one clear adult face photo and produces a roughly 12–15 second 9:16 MP4 using a locked blond bob and curled moustache deadpan template, with original AI ambient audio. It lists many demo scene templates (such as street shadowboxing, café terrace, and rooftop at sunset), each shown as a sample clip with sound. Pricing is one-time credit packs rather than a subscription, with a 480p standard option and 720p HD options. Failed generations return the credit automatically, and the page says renders usually take a few minutes. The page states it does not host or sell commercial songs, so users must add trending sounds themselves if they want them.
notable: Locked single template: one photo to a ~12–15s 9:16 blond bob + moustache clip
One-time credit packs with no subscription; failed generations refund credits
Many demo scene templates, each with sample clips shown on the site
Independent fan tool, explicitly not affiliated with the character's creator
caveats: Paid: from $6.90 per video; no free tier is mentioned
Adults 18+ only; face must be clearly visible
AI can miss beats; renders usually take a few minutes
Does not supply commercial songs; users must add audio themselves
